external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Vena started from the ground up at Canadian National Railway (CN) and worked in the Engineering, Mechanical and Operating departments, including operating trains as a locomotive engineer. After graduating from university, he worked in management across Operations, Marketing, Strategic Planning and Labor Relations at CN. Vena ultimately was promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer.

Vena has served on several transportation-related boards throughout his career, including most recently as chairman of the Association of American Railroads (AAR) and as a board member for Direct ChassisLink Inc. (DCLI) and FedEx.
